subject.title: Feature Request: Custom TUI Footer Fields for Cost/Balance/Rate Limit Status

question: Should OpenClaw expose persistent TUI footer customization through core config, a plugin status-provider API, a narrower /usage quota footer, or defer it outside core?
rationale: The request spans TUI UI, provider/auth data, config surface, and plugin API boundaries, and repository policy requires maintainer intent before adding that public surface.

options.title: Decide plugin API first
options.body: Use the open plugin status-provider direction as the generic seam, then decide TUI rendering, ordering, truncation, and provider-specific contributors separately.

options.title: Add core footer config
options.body: Accept a first-class TUI footer template/config surface, with explicit upgrade, security, polling, and provider data contracts.

options.title: Defer from core
options.body: Keep this as a plugin or ClawHub-style extension idea until a maintainer sponsors the needed core seam.

recommendation.title: Decide plugin API first
recommendation.body: Use the open plugin status-provider direction as the generic seam, then decide TUI rendering, ordering, truncation, and provider-specific contributors separately.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest current-main TUI footer and product-boundary history among the inspected routing candidates.
